note: Values are 0-100. chatty = chance to speak when chosen; lower = share of lines typed lower-case.

bots.name: Viper
bots.play: Always first through the door. Re-peeks the same angle once too often.
bots.chat: Never waits; types fast and lower-case.

bots.name: Blaze
bots.play: Sprints the first 10 seconds of every round. Chases kills too far.
bots.chat: Loudest bot on the team. Celebrates every kill.

bots.name: Havoc
bots.play: Loves close corners and tight rooms. Weak at range.
bots.chat: Short and blunt.

bots.name: Cobra
bots.play: Jiggle-peeks before committing. The careful entry.
bots.chat: Calls his peek before he takes it.

bots.name: Jackal
bots.play: Takes the fight even when outnumbered.
bots.chat: Cocky. Says 'ez' more than he should.

bots.name: Vandal
bots.play: Pushes through smoke. Throws his frag early.
bots.chat: Announces every grenade.

bots.name: Storm
bots.play: The entry who waits for the flash. Best paired with a support.
bots.chat: Asks for a flash, then goes.

bots.name: Warden
bots.play: Never leaves his site. Last to rotate.
bots.chat: Calm, full sentences, always a full stop.

bots.name: Rook
bots.play: Locks one lane with the machine gun and stays crouched.
bots.chat: Few words. Reports, never chats.

bots.name: Bishop
bots.play: Holds the cross angle and covers the other anchor.
bots.chat: Gives the team instructions: 'Hold.', 'Don't peek.'

bots.name: Kodiak
bots.play: Sits close to the objective and makes you come to him.
bots.chat: Dry. Unbothered when he dies.

bots.name: Sierra
bots.play: Rotates early on good information. Plays the retake well.
bots.chat: Clear rotate calls. Thanks people for info.

bots.name: Wolf
bots.play: The anchor who takes one early pick, then falls back.
bots.chat: Tells you when he gives up ground.

bots.name: Ghost
bots.play: Walks everywhere. Shows up behind you two minutes into the round.
bots.chat: Almost silent. When he talks, it matters.

bots.name: Shadow
bots.play: Waits for the team's push, then hits the back.
bots.chat: 'give me 5 sec'. Timing talk.

bots.name: Lynx
bots.play: Fast lurker. Takes the long way round at a run, then goes quiet.
bots.chat: Dry humour. 'lol' after a backstab.

bots.name: Mamba
bots.play: Sits in one off-angle per round and never the same one twice.
bots.chat: Tells you where he is hiding, once.

bots.name: Nomad
bots.play: Roams between lanes and feeds the team information.
bots.chat: More info calls than kills. Says 'btw' a lot.

bots.name: Onyx
bots.play: Hides close to the bomb after the plant.
bots.chat: Barely speaks. One-word answers.

bots.name: Reaper
bots.play: Hunts the last enemy alive. Good in the clutch.
bots.chat: Quiet until the clutch, then asks for silence.

bots.name: Sparrow
bots.play: Always second in. Throws the flash for the entry.
bots.chat: Friendliest bot. Thanks and encourages.

bots.name: Tango
bots.play: Smokes the crossing every round and re-smokes when it fades.
bots.chat: Counts down his utility.

bots.name: Yankee
bots.play: Trades the entry within a second or two.
bots.chat: 'I'll trade you'. Calls who he is behind.

bots.name: Frost
bots.play: Stays with the bomb carrier and covers the plant.
bots.chat: Calm helper. Offers to carry or defuse.

bots.name: Puma
bots.play: The aggressive support: flashes for himself when nobody goes.
bots.chat: Chatty. Apologises quickly.

bots.name: Saber
bots.play: Suppresses a lane so others can cross.
bots.chat: 'Covering, cross now.'

bots.name: Falcon
bots.play: Holds the longest line on the map. Relocates after every shot.
bots.chat: Clipped. 'Mine.'

bots.name: Raven
bots.play: Counter-sniper. Looks for the enemy scope first.
bots.chat: Calls the enemy sniper before anything else.

bots.name: Talon
bots.play: Aggressive scope. Peeks first, repositions late.
bots.chat: Admits his misses.

bots.name: Mako
bots.play: Rifle on single fire at range. Switches to the scope on long maps.
bots.chat: Talks range and lines.

bots.name: Hunter
bots.play: Covers the bomb from distance after the plant.
bots.chat: Tells the team which line he has.

bots.name: Ranger
bots.play: Overwatch for the entries. Shoots what they flush out.
bots.chat: 'Go. I have the angle.'
